title: Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo kwi-X (Twitter) Ngokulula
description: Indlela yokukhuphela iividiyo kwi-X (Twitter) kwifowuni okanye kwi-laptop ngaphandle kwe-app nokungena. Kopa ilinki, uyincamathisele kwi-I Need Save.
body:
I-X, eyayifudula ibizwa ngokuba yi-Twitter, idla ngokuba yindawo yokuqala apho iividiyo ezisasazekayo zivela khona: iziqwenga zeendaba, amaxesha emidlalo, ukuya kwii-meme wonke umntu athetha ngazo. Ingxaki kukuba ukugcina loo vidiyo kwi-gallery akusoloko kulula njengokucofa iqhosha elinye. Musa ukukhathazeka, ungakhuphela iividiyo kwi-X (Twitter) ngokulula nge-I Need Save. Simahla, ngaphandle kwe-app, nangaphandle kokungena.

Esi sikhokelo sichaza amanyathelo kwifowuni nakwikhompyutha, ukhetho lweefayile olukhoyo, nezisombululo ukuba ukukhuphela akuphumelelanga.

Phambi Kokuba Uqale

Qinisekisa ukuba ividiyo ofuna ukuyigcina ivela kokuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo. Okuthunyelweyo okuvela kwii-akhawunti ezitshixiweyo, umxholo obonakala kuphela emva kokungena, okanye umxholo othintelwe kwimimandla ethile awunakukhutshelwa.

Akufuneki kwakhona unike ukufikelela kwi-akhawunti yakho ye-X. I-I Need Save idinga kuphela ilinki yokuthunyelweyo.

Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo kwi-X (Twitter) kwiFowuni

La manyathelo asebenza kwi-Android nakwi-iPhone:

  1. Vula i-app ye-X uze ukhangele okuthunyelweyo okunevidiyo ofuna ukuyigcina.
  2. Cofa iqhosha elithi Yabelana (Share) kokuthunyelweyo.
  3. Khetha Kopa ilinki (Copy link).
  4. Vula i-browser uze undwendwele i-ineedsave.com.
  5. Ncamathisela ilinki kwibhokisi ekhoyo, okanye ucofe iqhosha elithi Ncamathisela.
  6. Cofa Khuphela uze ulinde kuvele ukhetho lweefayile.
  7. Khetha umgangatho wevidiyo owufunayo, uze ukukhuphela kuqale.

Ngamanye amaxesha iqhosha libonisa Iyalungiselela…. Kuthetha ukuba ividiyo iqala isetyenzwe, umzekelo i-stream iguqulelwa kwi-MP4 okanye ividiyo nesandi sayo ziyadityaniswa. Shiya iphepha livulekile, kwaye ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo xa ifayile ilungile.

Indlela Yokukhuphela Iividiyo ze-X kwi-Laptop okanye kwi-PC

Ukuba uvula i-X kwi-browser yekhompyutha, indlela nayo ilula ngokufanayo:

  1. Vula okuthunyelweyo okunevidiyo.
  2. Kopa ilinki yako kwimenyu ethi Yabelana okanye kwi-address bar.
  3. Vula iphepha lokukhuphela kwithebhu entsha uze uncamathisele ilinki.
  4. Cofa Khuphela, uze ukhethe ukhetho olufunayo.

Ifayile iya kugcinwa kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo) kwikhompyutha.

Ukhetho Oya Kulubona

Emva kokuba ilinki iqhutywe, i-I Need Save ibonisa ukhetho ngokokuthunyelweyo kokuqala. Ngokuqhelekileyo uya kufumana:

  • Ividiyo kwimigangatho eyahlukeneyo, umzekelo 360p, 720p, okanye 1080p. Ii-resolution ezikhoyo zixhomekeke kwividiyo efakiweyo.
  • Isandi, nokuba ngumgangatho wokuqala okanye i-MP3 ye-192 kbps eguqulwe kwividiyo.
  • Ifoto / Umfanekiso omncinci wokuthunyelweyo.

Ukhetho lwesandi luluncedo ukuba into oyidingayo lilizwi kuphela, umzekelo isiqwenga sodliwano-ndlebe okanye umculo. Ungafunda amanyathelo apheleleyo kwinqaku elithi indlela yokuguqula iividiyo zemidiya yoluntu zibe yi-MP3.

Icebiso: Ukuba ufuna nje ukuyibukela kwakhona kwifowuni, i-720p idla ngokucaca ngokwaneleyo kwaye ithatha indawo encinci kune-1080p.

Kutheni Usebenzisa i-I Need Save?

Kukho izinto ezimbalwa ezenza le ndlela ibe lula ukuyisebenzisa yonke imihla:

  • Akukho app. Yonke into isebenza kwi-browser, ngoko indawo yokugcina yefowuni ayisetyenziswa yi-app eyongezelelweyo.
  • Akukho kungena. Akufuneki uvule i-akhawunti okanye uqhagamshele i-akhawunti yakho ye-X.
  • Ayisiyo-X kuphela. Le ndlela inye ingasetyenziswa kwi-TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, nakwamanye amaqonga axhaswayo.
  • Imnandi ukuyisebenzisa. Isayithi ifumaneka ngeelwimi ezingama-93 kwaye ilandela umxholo okhanyayo okanye omnyama wesixhobo sakho.

Indawo Yefayile Emva Kokukhuphela

  • I-Android nekhompyutha: ifayile ingena kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Kwi-Android, i-app ye-Gallery ngamanye amaxesha ifuna ixesha elincinci phambi kokuba iyibonise.
  • I-iPhone/iPad (Safari): ifayile ingena kwi-app ethi Files, kwifolda ethi Downloads (Okukhutshelweyo). Ukuyidlulisela kwi-app ethi Photos, vula ividiyo kwi-Files, cofa Share (Yabelana), uze ukhethe Save Video (Gcina Ividiyo).

Iividiyo ze-MP4 ezikhutshelweyo zinobude bexesha obuchanekileyo kwaye zidlala kwii-app ze-gallery. Iifayile zikwadluliselwa ngqo zisuka kwi-X ziye kwisixhobo sakho, ngaphandle kokugcinwa kwiseva ye-I Need Save.

Ukuba Ukukhuphela Akuphumelelanga

Nazi ezinye zezizathu eziqhelekileyo:

  • I-akhawunti itshixiwe. Iividiyo ezivela kwii-akhawunti zabucala azinakuthathwa.
  • Kufuneka ungene. Umxholo obonakala kuphela emva kokungena kwi-akhawunti nawo awunakukhutshelwa.
  • Imida yommandla. Iividiyo ezithintelwe kumazwe athile azifumaneki.
  • Ilinki engachanekanga. Qinisekisa ukuba oko ukukopileyo yilinki yokuthunyelweyo, hayi ilinki yeprofayile. Yikope kwakhona kwiqhosha elithi Yabelana.

Musa Ukulibala Imigaqo Yokuziphatha

Gcina iividiyo kuphela ukuze uzisebenzisele wena. Ukuba ufuna ukwabelana ngazo kwakhona kwelinye iqonga, cela imvume kumdali uze ukhankanye igama lakhe. Ukuhlonipha ilungelo lokushicilela kugcina abadali bekhuthele ukudala. Funda nenqaku elithi imigaqo yokuziphatha nelungelo lokushicilela xa ukhuphela umxholo ukuze ufumane inkcazelo epheleleyo.

Imibuzo Ebuzwa Rhoqo

Ngaba i-I Need Save ingasetyenziswa kwi-iPhone?

Ewe. Vula i-ineedsave.com kwi-Safari, landela amanyathelo afanayo, uze ufumane ividiyo kwi-app ethi Files.

Ngaba kufuneka ndingene kwi-akhawunti yam ye-X?

Hayi. Ncamathisela nje ilinki yokuthunyelweyo okuvulelekileyo, ngaphandle kokungena nangaphandle kokuvula i-akhawunti.

Kutheni iqhosha libonisa Iyalungiselela…?

Loo vidiyo iyasetyenzwa, umzekelo i-stream iguqulelwa kwi-MP4. Ukukhuphela kuya kuqala ngokuzenzekelayo xa kugqityiwe.
